vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03c_opruimen.tekst: Sergeant Fluffball gave you two old practice weapons: worse than what you have now. Sell one at Cook Crispycrust's little camp shop on the square, and salvage the other at Sergeant Fluffball's camp smithy. Salvaging gives smithing stuff: gray gives dust, green splinters, blue and better crystals. The smith melts that into Upgrade Pebbles and more.

vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03c_opruimen.aanbod.0: Recruit! Here, two old practice weapons from the camp chest. Just look at your tooltip: worse than what you have now.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03c_opruimen.aanbod.1: You don't throw old stuff away. Selling gets you Chonkcoins, salvaging gets you smithing stuff for stars at the smith. A favorite piece? Press L in your inventory and it's locked.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03c_opruimen.aanbod.2: Sell one at Cook Crispycrust's little shop and salvage the other right here with me: I'm the camp smith too. Click me and choose 'Camp smithy'.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03c_opruimen.klaar.0: An old practice weapon for my little shop? Thank you! A tidy camp is a happy camp, I always say.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03c_opruimen.klaar.1: And remember: every shop and every smith has an 'all worse' button. One click and your old junk is gone.
vadsrijk.npc.tip.opruimen: Worse than what you're wearing? Sell it in a shop or salvage it into smithing stuff (at the smith, or with the button next to your inventory). Press L in your inventory to lock a favorite piece.
vadsrijk.npc.gids.opruimen.titel: What do I do with old stuff?
vadsrijk.npc.gids.opruimen.tekst: Your tooltip tells you right away: 'Worse than what you're wearing' or 'Better than what you're wearing', with the biggest difference, what it sells for and what salvaging gives. Selling gets you Chonkcoins. Salvaging gets you smithing stuff: gray gives Smithing Dust, green Smithing Splinters, blue and better Smithing Crystals (more for a higher level and for stars). The smith melts that down: 3 dust or 1 splinter become an Upgrade Pebble, 1 splinter can also become Fluff Thread, 2 crystals become Glitter Grit for your craft and 3 crystals a Reroll Nibble. Every shop and the smith have the buttons 'Sell all worse' and 'Salvage all worse': they only take pieces that are worse than what you're wearing, without stars or crystals, and never what you're wearing. A favorite piece? Press L in your inventory (or click the little lock): then it can't be sold, salvaged or traded. Blue and better always asks if you're sure first.
